tools.description: The external calendars (iCal feeds, a Google Calendar by its secret iCal address) connected to one boat, with their sync state. MMK and Nausys are linked automatically and are not listed here. An empty list means none is connected to that boat.

tools.name: add_calendar
tools.description: Connect an external calendar to a boat: its events block those dates on charter.boats. Returns the stored source; sync_calendar pulls it at once.

tools.name: remove_calendar
tools.description: Disconnect an external calendar: its blocked dates are freed, and the holds X-Lock placed for them on the partner calendars are released.

tools.name: sync_calendar
tools.description: Pull one external calendar now. Returns how many events it brought in, or the error the feed gave.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: The company's fleet calendar: every boat with its partner links, and every event that takes dates — bookings, options, blocks and synced partner or iCal events — each with its source. Read it before add_block to see what a range already holds.

tools.name: add_block
tools.description: Block dates on one of the operator's boats so they cannot be booked. On a partner-synced boat the hold is placed on that partner too, and with X-Lock on also on the other partner. Returns the stored block and how each hold went.

tools.name: remove_block
tools.description: Remove a block the operator placed, freeing its dates and releasing the partner holds it placed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_boats, get_poi_details, update_company, list_calendars · Private data: get_poi_details, get_location_details, get_company, update_company, list_calendars · Public sink: compare_boat, get_location_details, update_boat_images, update_company, get_cancellation_limits · Destructive: delete_boat_image, delete_discount, delete_price, delete_fee, remove_calendar, remove_block, get_opportunities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_boats, get_poi_details, update_company, list_calendars · Private data: get_poi_details, get_location_details, get_company, update_company, list_calendars · Public sink: compare_boat, get_location_details, update_boat_images, update_company, get_cancellation_limits · Destructive: delete_boat_image, delete_discount, delete_price, delete_fee, remove_calendar, remove_block, get_opportunities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
